  "pros": [
    "Effective for managing and sharing passwords across a small team.",
    "Centralized storage for secure notes and account details.",
    "Convenient cross-device synchronization of credentials."
  ],
  "cons": [
    "Occasional issues with browser extension performance or autofill.",
    "Concerns regarding recent security incidents and data breaches.",
    "User interface can sometimes feel clunky or less intuitive."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "The Member Manager found LastPass generally effective for their small entertainment company, appreciating its core functionality for managing and sharing passwords among a few employees over two years. While it provided good value for centralizing access, occasional reliability issues with browser extensions and recent security concerns tempered their overall satisfaction. They likely continued using it due to established workflows but with some reservations."
